title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: SOS resource uses PUT instead of POST — spec non-compliance
description:
In `python/src/lichen/coap/resources.py`, `SosResource.render_post` was renamed to `render_put`, changing the CoAP method for SOS activation from POST to PUT.

Per `spec/12-apps.md` line 609:
```
POST coap://[ff02::1]/sos
```

The spec consistently uses POST for SOS (also lines 613, 1229). Changing to PUT changes the HTTP method semantics and breaks spec compliance. The tests in `python/tests/coap/test_sos_resource.py` were also updated to use PUT, but they should use POST per the spec.

The change should be reverted: `render_put` → `render_post`, and the test imports/requests should use POST instead of PUT.
